description: This file defines a Flutter widget for an OTP verification screen, including UI components such as headers, input fields, buttons, and debug testing methods. It manages user interactions for OTP entry and provides debugging bypass features.

classes.name: OTPSecondScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that presents an OTP input screen with verification logic and debug bypass capability.

classes.name: _OTPSecondScreenState
classes.description: State class for OTPSecondScreen, manages UI state, user interactions, OTP verification, and debug bypass logic.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the TextEditingController to free resources.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including UI components for OTP input, header, and buttons.

methods.name: _onContinueTap
methods.description: Handles tap events on the Continue button, including triple-tap detection for debug bypass.

methods.name: _bypassOTPForTesting
